stories.title: Scientists find possible explanation for North Atlantic right whales’ low birth rates
stories.summary: Scientists are one step closer to understanding why the critically endangered population of North Atlantic right whales produces so few calves each year.

stories.title: N.B. commits $200K to support relatives caring for children unable to live with parents
stories.summary: The program, which is in partnership with the New Brunswick Adoption Foundation, help kinship caregivers create more stability and permanency for children and youth.

stories.title: Proposed Saint John data centre could generate tax windfall, critics unconvinced
stories.summary: The study on the proposed Spruce Lake data centre was commissioned by Beacon Data Centers, the company behind the proposal alongside U.S.-based VoltaGrid.

stories.title: Canada’s Alert Ready emergency system will test notifications on Wednesday
stories.summary: The emergency alerts are used by governments to inform the public of emergencies including tornadoes, floods, wildfires and Amber Alerts

stories.title: Strong calving season provides glimmer of hope for endangered right whales
stories.summary: The most recent calving season for North Atlantic right whales was one of the strongest on record, providing a glimmer of hope for the critically endangered species.

stories.title: PHAC finds no evidence of mystery brain disease in New Brunswick, says patients still need answers
stories.summary: The Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC) says it has found no evidence of a mystery brain disease that was allegedly affecting hundreds of New Brunswick residents.

stories.title: Four arrested, 220 charges laid in Cape Breton organized crime probe
stories.summary: The Cape Breton police probe began in July 2025 when police were called to find a stolen vehicle that was tracked to a property in Florence, N.S.

stories.title: Program that supports seniors living at home expands in rural New Brunswick
stories.summary: A new program in rural New Brunswick is bringing some of the benefits of a nursing home directly to the community.

stories.title: Atlantic Canadian padres honour Wainwright soldiers in Remembrance Day speeches
stories.summary: Two padres in Atlantic Canada led their Remembrance Day speeches on Wednesday with reflections on the recent deadly fire at CFB Wainwright, in Alberta.

stories.title: Wartime mystery solved as divers find wreck of ship torpedoed by German U-boat
stories.summary: The steamboat was heading from Barbados to New Brunswick in December 1944 when it was torpedoed by a German U-boat. Its wreckage was found this year.
